items.value: First Day of School
The schoolyard is crowded, everyone is watching. What will you do during the opening ceremony?
Sit nicely with the class.
You stayed quiet and got praised, though it felt boring. Next time teachers may trust you more with seating.
Whisper with your friend.
You were happy to talk again, but got reminded in front of the class. Next time teachers might separate you two.
Play a small game while waiting.
You had fun but almost got caught. Next time classmates may see you as the one who stirs things up.
Forgot Notebook
You forgot your notebook in class, teachers and friends are noticing.
Borrow some paper from a friend.
A friend helped you, but might hesitate if you forget again.
Ask the teacher for a sheet.
The teacher gave you paper but noted it down. Next time you might be called out.
Doodle on scratch paper.
You missed the lesson and got noticed. Next time your parent may be contacted.
Math Test
The class is silent, the test begins.
Do the test seriously.
You tried your best, though it was stressful. Next time teachers will trust your effort.
Peek at a friend's answers.
You copied some answers but raised suspicion. Next time you may lose friends’ trust.
Ask to leave mid-test.
You used health as an excuse, escaped for a bit. But teachers noted it and may call your parents next time.
Fire Alarm
The alarm rings, the class is panicked.
Line up with your class.
You stayed calm, teachers felt reassured. Next time you may lead the line.
Run around wildly.
You made things chaotic and got warned. Next time you may be moved away from friends.
Hold a friend's hand and run outside.
You stayed safe together but didn’t follow line rules. Next time teachers may watch you closely.
Oral Exam
The teacher is calling on students to answer.
Answer correctly.
You were confident and got praised, but now classmates notice you more. Next time you may be called often.
Stutter and forget.
You froze and couldn’t recall. Next time the teacher may write it down.
Pretend to cough.
You avoided this time, but the teacher remembers. Next time you might be called suddenly.
P.E. Class
The whistle blows, time to move.
Join the running.
You trained well, teacher noticed. Next time you may lead the group.
Pretend stomachache.
You skipped running, but teachers suspected. Next time you may be watched closely.
Play basketball instead.
You had fun but missed the main exercise. Next time teachers may limit the game.
Recess
The bell rings, everyone is excited.
Play with friends.
You had fun and bonded. Next time friends will invite you more.
Argue with a friend.
It got tense, teacher noted it. Next time you may be separated.
Read a comic quietly.
You enjoyed peace but seemed distant. Next time friends may not invite you.
Lunch in the Cafeteria
The cafeteria is noisy, many are watching.
Eat your own food.
You enjoyed the meal, teacher praised your manners. Next time you may sit with more friends.
Spill the tray.
You spilled food and felt embarrassed. Next time classmates may tease you.
Trade food with a friend.
You got your favorite dish but teacher warned you. Next time trading may be banned.
Performance Practice
The class is preparing for a show.
Practice seriously.
You learned your lines, teacher pleased. Next time you may get a lead role.
Forget the lines.
You froze, the group struggled. Next time you may get a smaller role.
Sing loudly off-key.
Class laughed, you felt awkward. Next time friends may remember you as the funny one.
Homework
School is over, homework awaits.
Finish it all.
You completed it, teacher praised you. Next time your reputation rises.
Forget to do it.
You got a note in the log. Next time parents may be called.
Rush through it.
You turned it in but with many mistakes. Next time teachers may check harder.
Reprimanded at Opening Ceremony
The teacher caught you talking during the opening ceremony and reprimanded you. How will you react?
Sit quietly and focus.
You showed respect and avoided further trouble. Next time the teacher may see you more positively.
Apologize sincerely and promise not to repeat.
Your apology was accepted, but the incident was noted. Next time the teacher will watch you closely.
Keep whispering softly, hoping not to be noticed.
You ignored the warning, risking harsher punishment. Next time you might lose conduct points or have your parents called.
Punished for Forgetting Notebook
The teacher punished you for not bringing your notebook.
Copy lines on another sheet.
You had to write tiring lines. Next time the teacher will check your notebook more carefully.
Stay after class to submit.
You lost recess finishing it. Next time you may get a note in the log.
Lose diligence points.
Your grade dropped, affecting your record. Next time your parents may be informed.
Warning During Test
The invigilator stared at you and gave a warning during the test. What will you do?
Pretend not to hear and continue.
You took the risk of being caught. Next time punishment will be harsher.
Sit up straight and focus on your own work.
You corrected yourself quickly and avoided more trouble, but the invigilator kept watching.
Panic and stop writing.
Fear overwhelmed you, leaving the test unfinished. Next time your grade and reputation may suffer.
Lost During Fire Drill
You got separated from your class during the drill. What will you do?
Follow another group.
You joined another group, but the teacher noted it. Next time you may be kept close to the teacher.
Wait in the yard.
You stayed calm until your class found you. Next time teachers will remind you to stay close.
Run frantically to find the teacher.
You caused a scene, so next time the teacher may assign someone to guide you.
Copying Punishment
You were told to copy as punishment for not memorizing your lesson, and classmates are watching.
Start copying right away.
You finished and avoided a parent call, but the teacher will check your preparation more.
Ask a classmate to remind you in exchange for supplies.
You got help today, but the teacher noticed and may change your seat.
Ask for mercy at the risk of a note.
You avoided copying, but the teacher wrote a note and warned that next time your parents will be called.
Teased by Friends
Your friends teased you for faking a stomachache.
Laugh it off.
You laughed to keep the peace, but friends may bring it up again.
Insist you were honest.
You tried convincing them, but trust decreased. Next time they may doubt you.
Run to play to prove it.
You proved yourself but felt embarrassed. Next time friends may challenge you more.
Called to the Office
You were sent to the office after arguing.
Argue back to defend yourself.
You defended your side but were seen as defiant. Next time you may get a discipline note.
Stay silent and take it.
You avoided more trouble but seemed unresponsive. Teachers may think you lack accountability.
Apologize quickly to end it.
You apologized, and the matter ended. Next time teachers may expect you to be proactive.
Clean the Table
You had to clean the whole table after spilling your tray.
Clean carefully.
You cleaned well, showing responsibility. Next time teachers trust you more.
Do it carelessly.
You wiped quickly and friends teased you. Next time you may get more chores.
Ask a friend to help.
A friend helped, but you seemed dependent. Next time the teacher may watch you closely.
Role Replaced
You lost your role for not knowing your lines.
Ask for a smaller role.
You still participated but less noticeably. Next time the teacher may value your persistence.
Watch from the audience.
You sat out and felt sad. Next time friends may not rely on you.
Practice hard and ask for another chance.
You worked hard, and the teacher noticed. Next time you may be given another try.
Reprimanded for Homework
The teacher scolded you for forgetting homework.
Apologize to the teacher.
You admitted your mistake, but the teacher will keep watch.
Blame circumstances.
You made excuses, but trust decreased. Next time parents may be called.
Promise to do it next time.
You promised, but the teacher remembered. Next time you may face harsher consequences.
Fighting Over a Toy
You and a classmate are fighting over a toy.
Talk and share.
You decided to take turns. Next time you may be praised for fairness.
Cry and tell the teacher.
You told the teacher and it was solved, but classmates may tease you as weak.
Find another toy.
You avoided conflict by playing with something else. Next time friends may see you as adaptable.
Drawing in Art Class
It is art class, and you are drawing.
Draw according to the theme.
You followed directions, pleasing the teacher but lacking creativity.
Add creative details.
You were praised as unique, though some friends teased you as odd.
Borrow colors from a friend.
You spent time borrowing crayons, not drawing much. Next time you may be reminded to bring supplies.
Rainy Recess
It is raining during recess.
Play inside the classroom.
You played board games indoors. Next time classmates may invite you for indoor fun.
Run outside in the drizzle.
You had fun but got wet, risking a cold.
Watch the rain from the hallway.
You enjoyed the peace. Next time friends may see you as quiet.
Classmate's Birthday
You are at a classmate's birthday party.
Give a small gift.
Your gift made your friend happy.
Sing Happy Birthday.
You sang loudly, and everyone joined. Next time friends may want you in celebrations.
Eat cake and candy.
The cake was delicious, but teachers may notice if you eat too much.
First Time Speaking Up
You have a chance to speak for the first time.
Speak clearly and confidently.
You were nervous but spoke up. Next time teachers may trust you more.
Speak quietly while trembling.
You were too shy to be heard. Next time classmates may pay less attention.
Forget what to say.
You froze, and the class stared. Next time teachers may remind you to prepare.
Extracurricular Club
You are thinking about joining a club.
Register seriously.
You were excited, and the teacher encouraged you. Next time you may be given a role.
Try one session then quit.
You found it boring and left. Next time teachers may hesitate to let you join.
Join to make friends.
You made new friends, but sometimes ignored the activity.
Playing Soccer in the Yard
You are playing soccer with friends.
Play enthusiastically.
You had fun and were cheered. Next time friends want you on their team.
Be a cheerleader.
You supported loudly but missed playing. Next time you may not be picked for the team.
Be the goalie.
You blocked some shots and felt proud. Next time you may keep that role.
Sports Day
It is the annual school sports day.
Run in the sprint.
You ran as fast as you could. Next time you may be chosen again.
Jump rope.
You had fun jumping. Next time friends may invite you to play.
Cheer loudly.
You stood out as a supporter. Next time teachers may assign you as cheer captain.
Classroom Game
The teacher organizes a game.
Play by the rules.
You played fair and had fun. Next time friends trust you more.
Cheat a little.
You won but were caught. Next time your reputation drops.
Quit halfway.
You got bored and stopped. Next time you may not be picked.
First Museum Trip
You are visiting the museum for the first time.
Listen to the guide.
You learned many things. Next time the teacher praises your focus.
Look at objects only.
The artifacts amazed you, but you missed the explanations.
Chat with friends.
You missed the content while talking. Next time teachers may warn you.
Spelling Test
Today is the spelling test.
Write seriously.
You spelled confidently and did well. Next time you are seen as diligent.
Look at a friend's paper.
You peeked for help but got noticed.
Write a different sentence instead.
You avoided hard words, losing points. Next time you need practice.
Receive a Good Student Certificate
You received a certificate for being a good student.
Show it proudly to parents.
Your parents were proud. Next time they encourage you more.
Show it to friends.
Your friends congratulated you. Next time they respect you more.
Put it quietly in your bag.
You felt happy but humble. Next time you are seen as modest.
Singing in Class
You are singing during music class.
Sing in tune.
You enjoyed singing and got praise. Next time you may be chosen to solo.
Sing very quietly.
You were shy and quiet. Next time teachers may encourage you more.
Giggle while singing.
You laughed and disrupted. Next time teachers may warn you.
Praised by Teacher
The teacher praised you in front of the class.
Blush shyly.
You were not used to attention. Next time teachers may encourage you again.
Smile proudly.
You felt happy being recognized. Next time friends admire you.
Act casual.
You acted calm but felt proud inside.
Reprimanded for Talking
The teacher scolded you for talking in class.
Sit quietly.
You stopped and avoided more trouble. Next time the teacher keeps an eye on you.
Argue back.
You defended yourself but looked defiant. Next time parents may be called.
Apologize.
You apologized, and it ended. Next time the teacher expects better behavior.
First Bad Grade
You got your first bad grade.
Cry sadly.
You were disappointed. Next time you are more determined.
Hide it from parents.
You kept it secret but risk being found out.
Decide to study harder.
You promised yourself to improve. Next time teachers may encourage you.
Group Work
You are working on a group project.
Share ideas.
You led the discussion. Next time friends rely on you more.
Let friends decide.
You stayed quiet. Next time your role may be smaller.
Only do your part.
You did your task. Next time you may be seen as supportive.
Found a Lost Item
You found a lost item.
Return it to the owner.
Your friend was happy. Next time you are praised as honest.
Turn it in to the teacher.
The teacher helped find the owner. Next time you are trusted.
Keep it for yourself.
You kept it but risk being caught. Next time your reputation drops.
Appointed Class Monitor
You were appointed class monitor.
Accept happily.
You promised responsibility. Next time the teacher trusts you more.
Decline.
You avoided responsibility. Next time teachers pick someone else.
Suggest another friend.
You thought your friend fit better. Next time teachers reconsider.
Craft Class
You are in craft class.
Fold as instructed.
You followed carefully. Next time teachers praise your diligence.
Fold creatively into another shape.
You made a paper airplane, fun but off-task.
Work slowly and not finish.
You ran out of time. Next time teachers remind you to be faster.
